subject: Privacy follow-up: DPA, SCC module recommendation & VSQ kickoff
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@finbright.com>, Marco Vitale <m.vitale@finbright.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 13:12:00 -0700
Subject: Privacy follow-up: DPA, SCC module recommendation & VSQ kickoff

Hi Elena / Marco — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so everyone is aligned.

Call highlights:
- Scope: FinBright will process user account and transaction metadata; potential PII in user profiles; no PHI on our side based on current integration, but you flagged logs that could include health attrs for a small pilot.
- SOC 2: Redwood is mid-cycle (Type II in progress). I shared our SOC 2 bridge notes and the SOC 2 summary (attached).
- DPA / SCC: You asked whether Redwood is a processor or joint-controller for any telemetry. Our legal recommendation: Redwood is the processor for product usage, telemetry, and embeddings. That implies SCC module = Controller-to-Processor (Module 2) under the 2021 SCC structure.
- VSQ (vendor security questionnaire): FinBright prefers to run your standard questionnaire; we can start the questionnaire and send supporting evidence (SOC 2 summary, network diagram).

Proposed immediate actions (owner / ETA):
1) Redwood legal to share a short DPA draft reflecting Controller->Processor role and Module 2 SCC selection. (Owner: Lauren) — deliver by EOD Thu 2026-08-20. Attachment: redwood-dpa-draft-20260818.pdf
2) Security team to send VSQ template to Redwood security mailbox (security@redwood.com) and request initial evidence list. (Owner: FinBright) — target kickoff by Wed 2026-08-19. Attachment: vendor-security-questionnaire-template.xlsx
3) Redwood to provide SOC 2 summary and relevant artifacts for VSQ. (Owner: Redwood security / Monica) — initial package by Fri 2026-08-21. Attachment: soc2-summary-2026.pdf
4) Discuss potential HIPAA implications for that small pilot if logs include health attributes — schedule a 30-minute follow-up with legal. (Owner: Karthik + FinBright legal) — propose times next week.

Please confirm the SCC module recommendation works for you, and whether FinBright needs any specific controller-side language (e.g., additional logging retention constraints) in the DPA. If you want, we can mark up the DPA with a short redline set to speed review.

Thanks,
Karthik
Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-dpa-draft-20260818.pdf (DPA draft, 3 pages); soc2-summary-2026.pdf (summary, 2 pages); vendor-security-questionnaire-template.xlsx (your VSQ template)
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@finbright.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marco Vitale <m.vitale@finbright.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Privacy follow-up: DPA, SCC module recommendation & VSQ kickoff

Thanks, Karthik — helpful recap. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

1) Module alignment: Controller->Processor (Module 2) is what we expected for the core product data — good to confirm. For the pilot that may include health attributes, we need to understand whether Redwood will process those attributes as a processor or if FinBright will pseudonymize before transit. If Redwood processes raw attributes, we will likely treat that dataset as PHI for the pilot and need HIPAA controls called out.

2) SOC 2 timing: Can you confirm when the Type II report will be available? The summary looks good but our procurement needs the report date and whether there are any open exceptions.

3) VSQ: We'll have security@finbright.com send the questionnaire to security@redwood.com. Expect a DocuSign for a DPA once legal aligns on the module. Can you share a short list of the evidence items you'll be able to provide immediately (network diagram, encryption at rest, subprocessors list)?

If you can send the DPA redline suggestion and evidence list by Thursday that would be perfect.

Best,
Elena Rossi
Head of Legal Ops, FinBright
elena.rossi@finbright.com

On Tue, Aug 18, 2026 at 13:12, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com> wrote:

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Privacy follow-up: DPA, SCC module recommendation & VSQ kickoff

Looping in Monica for security evidence. Quick notes from legal standpoint and suggested language we should include in the DPA draft before sending to FinBright: 

- Role: Redwood = Processor for: product telemetry, embeddings, user account metadata, and transactional logs. We will not assert Controller status for those datasets.
- SCC: Recommend Controller->Processor (Module 2) with the standard Processor Annex wording.
- Pilot with potential health attributes: add a conditional clause: if FinBright sends PHI, parties will execute a BAA or equivalent addendum and agree on technical/physical safeguards; until BAA executed Redwood will treat data as non-PHI and apply standard processing (we should flag this as a negotiation item).
- Subprocessors: include clause that we will notify FinBright for material changes and provide subprocessors list on request; propose 30-day notice for new subprocessors.
- Retention & deletion: FinBright requested a 90-day retention window for raw logs; propose we accept 90 days for logs, longer retention options by mutual agreement.

Attachment: proposed-dpa-snippets.txt (short bullet points we can drop into the draft). Once Karthik approves, I'll convert to a short redline and send to Elena.

Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

- I'll propose 3 times for a 30-minute legal/security sync next week (aiming for Tue/Wed morning PT) — I'll include a Calendly link in a separate email.

Owners / ETA recap: Lauren (DPA redline) — Thu 8/20; Monica (evidence bundle) — Fri 8/21; FinBright security (VSQ kickoff) — Wed 8/19.

If that timeline works I'll mark this as the plan and start the DocuSign workflow once Elena confirms no major DPA changes.

Thanks,
Karthik
